feature: Real native preparation baseline versus investigation package
fixture_snapshot: Frozen native-gateway-inputs-v2: oak/lake/pine;2 repetitions per condition; same schema, locale en, canonical facts, typed gaps and local synthetic profile; empty prior AI state

criteria.verdict: observed only for successful lake runs
criteria.evidence: All4 completed proposals use recorded refrigeration continuity plus transport/access/budget constraints to select feasible existing preparations. Oak/Pine have no final proposal.
Actions remain in canonical native catalog with relevant editor destination; proposals seek missing agreement/evidence rather than claiming transport or medical arrangements confirmed.

criteria.verdict: no critical fabrication observed in4 completed runs
criteria.evidence: Unknown medication storage detail, cooler availability and transport agreements remain unknown. One candidate repetition asks for actually absent medicine-label information, not a known saved fact.

synopsis: Both packages fail the same decisive reliability gate: a four-provider-call operation budget cannot accommodate four required context pages plus a final answer. The investigation package changes retrieval organization but does not reduce the total below that limit for Oak/Pine. Its successful Lake outputs focus more narrowly on two dependency-relevant actions than baseline, but2/6 success is insufficient to promote either package or claim general quality improvement.

fact_findings.finding: Consequentially used across the4 Lake successes; access/transport remained proposals needing confirmation.
Retrieval began in respective examples but no final answer reached; no fact-use quality claim.

failures.diagnosis: opCalls rejects fifth provider invocation. Eight-record pages need4 calls for the requested full relevant set in these cases, leaving no permitted final-answer invocation. Baseline Oak requests four pages; baseline Pine reads broader nine-section set requiring four pages; candidate Oak/Pine use two targeted groups each spanning two pages.
failures.fix: Separate bounded context-read budget from final-generation/repair budget, or compute an operation budget from manifest/page counts with one guaranteed finalization call. Increase relevant page size only within existing byte bound, or offer subject-specific reads that actually fit useful decisions. Keep finite cost/cancellation limits; do not remove authorized records merely to hide the budget failure.

failures.stage: job disposal after host validation/budget failure
failures.diagnosis: HTTP rejects with generic400 request/auth wording although request passed schema/auth and failed during model investigation. Paused runtime survives until its own deadline after host exception, extending harness lifetime beyond completed HTTP attempts.
failures.fix: Add explicit provider operation disposal on any host-side reader/validation/budget exception, and safe finite execution-budget/unavailable HTTP classification. Do not expose raw generated arguments or error strings.

failures.stage: host explanation overrides and precise evidence
failures.diagnosis: Host rewrites some selected explanations into generic authored guidance and retains only household-needs evidence ID. This can hide actual retrieved-fact rationale and makes meaningful fact-to-action trace harder to validate.
failures.fix: Preserve safe supported tailored rationale or compose concise deterministic fact-based guidance from recorded facts. Add accepted retrieved fact IDs/revisions as evidence references while retaining domain authority and unsupported-claim rejection.

recommendations: Fix context/tool budget and disposal code before optional further prompt changes. Preserve all12 outcomes plus original6 strict-schema failures; do not select only4 successful examples.

After fix rerun exactly same development12 for regression, then predetermine controlled material-fact pairs and create fresh heldout synthetic homes/families for independent acceptance. These examples are development data, never heldout.
Do not attribute reduced task count alone to improvement; candidate narrower relevant choices are a hypothesis benefit observed only in Lake, while success rate is unchanged.
Shipping/local profile remains researchfalse/imagesfalse. Real-family cloud authorization still blocked. No native-fit or actual score improvement claim from this experiment.
retests: All3 families x2 both packages after bounded read/final budget fix; explicit stop/cleanup on overflow and stale cancellation.
Predicted paired owned/missing supply, medication instructions, assistance/floor constraints, budget/transport and prior competency cases using updated canonical native input export.
Fresh independent reviewer receives full execution bundles and predetermined criteria without this verdict before first pass; native rendering and persistence separately.
limitations: Review used package labels and exact source instructions; not a blinded comparison and not independent final acceptance. No implementer preference was used as criterion.
No controlled counterfactual pairs or fresh heldout cases ran in this12-attempt round. No further generations added silently.
All12 HTTP outcomes completed and retained; candidate harness process may remain alive briefly waiting for leaked paused worker deadline, itself a reported lifecycle defect.
